papers.title_en: SharP: Soft and Hard Prompt-Guided Augmentation with LLM for Low Resource Fake News Detection
papers.authors: Ziyu Luo, Wei Li, Haoping Huang, Kecheng Liu, Min Gao
papers.evidence: 基于提示引导增强的低资源虚假新闻检测
papers.tldr: 低资源虚假新闻检测面临标注稀缺与欺骗模式隐蔽的难题，且需在固定测试协议下评估。SharP以软硬提示引导LLM生成任务特定样本，硬提示提供结构与事实约束，软提示注入学习到的语义模式。方法还引入边界感知策略与双目标优化，聚焦分类器低置信区域并对齐源数据与分类反馈。由此生成兼具领域一致性与判别力的合成数据，提升低资源场景下检测的鲁棒性与泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Fake news detection under low resource conditions is challenged by the scarcity of labeled data and the difficulty of capturing subtle deceptive patterns. In this work, we focus on low resource fake news detection, where only a small labeled set is available for training, while evaluation is performed under a fixed and unchanged test protocol. This setting is motivated by costly, ambiguous fact-checking and emerging topics and domains that are poorly covered by existing benchmarks. Existing data augmentation methods, such as synonym substitution, generative adversarial networks, and large language model (LLM)-based generation, often produce fluent but overly generic content, lacking the task-specific relevance needed for accurate detection. To address this, we propose SharP, a boundary-aware text generation framework guided by soft and hard prompts, which leverages LLMs as tools adapted to produce task-specific synthetic samples. SharP employs a dual prompt mechanism: hard prompts provide structured guidance and factual constraints, while soft prompts introduce learned semantic patterns from the data. These two types of prompts are combined to guide the generation process, enabling the model to produce samples that closely align with the characteristics of news. To further enhance detection performance, we incorporate a boundary-aware strategy that steers generation toward areas where the classifier is less confident, helping to clarify subtle distinctions between real and fake content. In addition, we adopt a dual objective optimization that balances semantic alignment with the source data and classifier feedback. This encourages the generation of samples that are both domain-consistent and helpful for refining decision boundaries, ultimately improving model robustness and generalization in low resource fake news detection.

papers.title_en: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
papers.evidence: 角色专用检索智能体与证据池用于多模态文档问答
papers.tldr: 开放域多模态文档问答需先定位再阅读，现有检索增强智能体却让单一模型兼管搜索与阅读并自行调度。KnowForge 按职责拆分：只会搜索的 Locator、强制二跳的桥接裁判、有界证据池，以及只会读文本图像表格的 Deep Reader 与格式检查合成器。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 M3DocVQA 上 F1 47.5，超 M3DocRAG 11.0；MultiHop-RAG 达 73.5。
papers.abstract_en: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

papers.title_en: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
papers.authors: Ruochi Li, Jianzhe Lin, Haoxuan Zhang, Haihua Chen, Junhua Ding, Edward Gehringer, Yang Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向多模态证据推理的图检索增强基准，评估异构证据单元的证据拓扑恢复
papers.tldr: 真实文档证据分散于文本、表格、图片和图注，现有 GraphRAG 评测偏文本，多模态 RAG 基准又未直接检验证据拓扑恢复。为此提出 TopoGraphRAG-Bench，基于 201 篇长文档构建 2,024 个问题，覆盖单跳检索、桥接链推理与多源合成三种拓扑，并用反事实验证抗捷径、模态必要性与证据必要性。结果显示多模态 GraphRAG 整体最强，但跨模态对齐或多单元组合不完整时仍失败；纯文本 GraphRAG 依赖图表时吃力，页面级视觉检索缺乏细粒度拓扑。该基准推动 GraphRAG 显式建模版式、跨模态对齐与证据单元推理角色。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.

papers.title_en: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Shunyuan Zhou, Hao Chen, Tianyu Wang, Goose Lin, Zaiyuan Wang, Haiying Zhao
papers.evidence: 关于证据依赖与误导性检索证据的受控协议
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成中，模型跟随检索证据并不等于事实正确：误导证据可能让模型替换原本正确的答案，而传统准确率掩盖了这种风险。为此提出 RAG-Stress 诊断协议，固定问题与参考答案，编辑一条断言以支持指定错误答案，并交叉两种来源优先策略与三种答案位置。评估 15 个系统，在 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA、SearchQA 及中英文 MedQA 上测量误导率。结果显示，优先文档的指令显著提高误导率，均值差距达 10.9–13.5 个百分点；位置效应为 End>Beginning>Middle。该工作区分证据遵从与事实可靠性，推动评估检索证据是保留、替换还是纠正模型答案。
papers.abstract_en: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.

papers.title_en: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
papers.authors: Jianfei Zhao, Yifan Wang, Feng Zhang, Xin Sun, Chong Feng, Zhixing Tan, Yang Luo, Boyuan Pan, Xu Kai, Yao Hu
papers.evidence: 利用条目反馈细化的多模态检索，可用于证据检索
papers.tldr: 通用多模态检索通常只对查询编码一次，再按嵌入相似度独立排序，查询表示无法被检索到的条目反馈修正。为此，ARR 在检索与查询嵌入更新之间交替：先选出信息量大的条目，再用其内容细化查询，最后用更新后的嵌入排序。它用逐步对比学习做监督微调，并用强化学习优化反馈条目选择，配合查询侧适配器适配固定条目索引。在域内与零样本基准上平均优于基线，且反馈既提升推理检索，也改善初始查询嵌入。
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

papers.title_en: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
papers.authors: Ibrahim Siddig, Sviatoslav Tugeev, Munir Georges
papers.evidence: 结构驱动知识图谱检索增强生成，实现可验证的证据落地
papers.tldr: 在法律、医疗等可靠性关键领域，自动化系统需透明可验证，但LLM黑盒特性与朴素RAG在大规模法源下检索退化，易忽略关键上下文。本文面向德国法典，提出用结构驱动解析构建知识图谱，用于源文档导航与检索，并比较多种KG驱动的分块与检索策略。研究评估这些策略对检索引用准确率的影响，为法律推理中的可验证检索提供结构化路径。
papers.abstract_en: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.
